svg.aria-label: Two stacked bar charts titled 'Who's actually online, by the numbers.' First bar: share of global web traffic in June 2026, per Cloudflare — 57.5% automated (bot and agent) traffic versus 42.5% human traffic, the first time the automated share has crossed half, marked 'bots cross 50% for the first time.' Second bar: share of newly published web pages in 2025 containing detectable AI-generated text, per Ahrefs — 74.2% with AI-generated content versus 25.8% without. A footnote adds that Google says 86% of the articles it surfaces in search are still human-written, and that Cloudflare's own CEO argues the crossover is agents doing useful work, not bots talking to bots.
svg.text: Who's actually online, by the numbers
Two separate counts. Neither one is a vibe.
bots cross 50% for the first time
New web pages with detectable AI text, 2025
Counter-reading: Google says 86% of articles it surfaces in search are still
human-written. Cloudflare's own CEO calls the bot majority proof the net is
busier, not deader — agents doing errands, not bots talking to bots.
